newsitem.title: USA: Merisel outlines restructuring in filing.
newsitem.headline: Merisel outlines restructuring in filing.

text.p: Merisel Inc Friday said it has amended an S-4 registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission outlining its proposed debt restructuring plan.

In a statement, Merisel said the new registration updates its filing on June 27. As it has previously stated, Merisel reiterated that it will continue with its existing restructuring proposal and plans to begin a stockholder solicitation and noteholder exchange offer next week.

Merisel also disclosed that Stonington Partners Inc, which has offered to make an equity infusion into Merisel, received a summons and complaint from the ad hoc noteholders' committee of Merisel's 12.5 percent senior notes alleging tortious interference with Merisel's waiver agreement with noteholders. Merisel was not named as a party in the suit. Stonington has indicated that it intends to defend the suit vigorously.

The suit relates to a Stonington proposal to make a $152 million equity infusion in exchange for 70 percent of Merisel's common stock if the waiver agreement is terminated before a restructuring is completed.
Such proposal cannot be accepted under the current terms of the waiver agreement, Merisel said.
